data.name: Orcalypse
data.detailed_description:
Deep within a forgotten forest lies a clearing untouched by time… and cursed by something far worse.

In Orcalypse, you are the lone survivor stranded in a desolate glade where the earth cracks open and unholy terrors rise. Waves of undead and savage orcs crawl from beneath the soil, driven by a dark force that won’t stop until you're buried beneath it.

There are no allies. No escape. Only the relentless sound of snarling beasts and your weapon—your only hope in a hopeless place. Occasionally, fallen foes drop precious upgrades to boost your fire rate and give you a fighting chance... for a little while.

But the horde never ends. The forest never sleeps. And something deeper… watches.

Features:

  • Atmospheric setting in a cursed woodland clearing

  • Endless survival gameplay with rising difficulty

  • Tight, responsive combat against grotesque enemies

  • Upgrade mechanics to evolve your firepower mid-fight

  • Selection of characters with unique strengths and weaknesses

Orcalypse is not about winning—it's about delaying the inevitable.

data.short_description: Shoot, dodge, survive, and upgrade as endless waves of zombies and orcs burst from the ground and rush you. Hold the line, collect power-ups, and fight to stay alive as long as you can!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7 / 10 / 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 (2nd generation) or equivalent AMD processor
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 3000 or better (supports OpenGL 3.3+)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 300 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • VR Support: Not supported
  • Additional Notes: Game runs as a portable version without installer
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or better
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GT 710 / AMD Radeon R5 or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • VR Support: Not supported
  • Additional Notes: The game works well even on lower-end systems

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Distribution with glibc 2.28+ (e.g., Ubuntu 20.04+, Fedora 30+, Arch)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 (2nd generation) or equivalent AMD processor
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated (Intel HD Graphics with OpenGL 3.3+ support)
  • Storage: 300 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Compatible with ALSA / PulseAudio
  • VR Support: Not supported
  • Additional Notes: Can be run without installation, works on most desktop environments (X11 / Wayland)
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS or newer / Latest Arch, Fedora versions
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or better
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA (with open drivers or proprietary), AMD, Intel Iris
  • Storage: 500 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Compatible with ALSA / PulseAudio / PipeWire
  • VR Support: Not supported
  • Additional Notes: Tested on X11 and Wayland; works on Steam Deck (desktop mode)
